verdict.rationale: Langfuse docs say traces capture all LLM and non-LLM steps (retrieval, embeddings, API calls), that agentic workflows can be shown as a graph, and that multi-turn conversations can be grouped into sessions with user tracking. Capture works through native Python/JS SDKs, OpenTelemetry/OTLP and 100+ integrations, and community users single out its tracing for debugging complex LLM pipelines. One user reports that structured-output retries clutter traces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the nested span/observation hierarchy, and a fix for cluttered traces when retries occur.
